statusLine.command: jq -r 'def fmtpct: if . == null then "--" else ((.*10|round)/10|tostring) + "%" end; def fmtk: if . == null then "--" else (((./1000)*10|round)/10|tostring) + "k" end; "\u001b[90m" as $g | "\u001b[38;5;153m" as $b | "\u001b[0m" as $x | (.context_window.total_input_tokens // null) as $ctx | (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // null) as $five | (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // null) as $week | $g + "context: " + $b + ($ctx|fmtk) + $g + "  |  5h: " + ($five|fmtpct) + "  |  7d: " + ($week|fmtpct) + "  |  " + (.model.display_name // "--") + $x'
